content: dsl.ParallelFor(items, parallelism=N) fans a sub-DAG out over a static list; parallelism caps concurrent iterations (0 = unconstrained). dsl.Collected fans results back in from a ParallelFor loop (v2 native replacement for v1 exit-handler-based collection). For a 16GB laptop, capping parallelism to 2-3 concurrent iterations is the standard way to bound resource use.
